sources.label: X — @realDonaldTrump (discovery via Grok, text verified verbatim)
sources.notes: FIRST CHOICE for X. Grok (xAI live search, sources:[{type:'x'}]) is asked only WHICH posts exist; the words are then fetched verbatim by tools/x-verify.mjs from a public mirror, so a model's paraphrase can never reach the store. A post that cannot be resolved verbatim is dropped. Confirm the key and request shape with: node tools/ingest.mjs --selftest=x-grok

sources.label: X — @realDonaldTrump (official API v2)
sources.notes: Alternative to the Grok route: reads the timeline straight from X. Needs an X developer app bearer token, and X's free tier cannot read another account's posts, so this needs the paid Basic tier (~US$200/mo). Kept because it is the one route with no third-party mirror in the middle.

sources.label: Truth Social (Trump's Truth archive feed) — stands in while X discovery is dark
sources.notes: His own posts, full text, one stable URL per post (trumpstruth.org/statuses/<id>), no auth needed. Stands in for the X feed while X access is unresolved — and it is the same words, since he cross-posts.

sources.label: NPR Politics
sources.notes: News reports that quote him; the article URL is the receipt. Not a transcript.

sources.label: Reddit meme subs (r/TrumpMeme, r/PoliticalHumor, r/QuotesPorn)
sources.notes: Reddit's robots.txt disallows all generic crawlers (User-agent: * / Disallow: /), so the anonymous Atom feed route is off-limits for a bot in a public repo. This source therefore uses Reddit's credentialed app API (free 'script' app, client_credentials grant) when REDDIT_CLIENT_ID and REDDIT_CLIENT_SECRET are set, and stays disabled otherwise. Meme-derived candidates arrive tagged from-meme and cannot be published until a second, non-meme source corroborates them.

sources.label: GDELT DOC 2.0 (global news search)
sources.notes: Disabled by default: the free endpoint asks for at most one request every 5 seconds and throttles bursts. Enable per run with --source=gdelt.

sources.label: The American Presidency Project — remarks & transcripts
sources.notes: Primary transcripts. Enable per run with --source=presidency-ucsb; its robots.txt sets Crawl-delay: 10, so a run takes minutes.
